content: Official Phoenix v1.8.9 guides organize documentation into introduction/get-first-app material, in-depth component guides, data modelling, authn/authz, real-time, testing, deployment, and how-to groupings. Official Ecto v3.14.1 getting-started guide demonstrates a first-success tutorial that walks from app creation through dependency setup and concrete database operations. Together they support Scoria's Start Here then capability/domain guide ordering.
